roles.name: FOUNDATION
roles.doc: The Foundation: configuration, the pause, and the bootstrap of the first GTAs. AccessControl's DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, so it also administers every other role.

roles.name: SERVER
roles.doc: The backend service account: the identity flag, and nothing else that moves value (FM p2).

roles.name: HOLDER
roles.doc: A country Trust Admin -- the Holder of the covenants its verifiers verify.

roles.name: GUARDIAN
roles.doc: A landowner. Granted by the protocol at its first mint; nobody admits a guardian.

roles.name: EMERGENCY
roles.doc: The Foundation's emergency multisig: the emergency freeze of a Holder and the emergency pause, both of which lapse after 30 days (FM p4, P5, P11). Held directly, not behind the root's timelock.
